title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what personal information PaydayStubs.com collects, why we collect it, how long we keep it and the choices you have.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
list: Account and contact details: your name, email address and, if you add it, your phone number and profile photo.
Document details: the employer, employee and pay information you enter to create a document, which may include a Social Security number.
Order and payment records: what you bought, amounts, dates and the card brand and last four digits. Card numbers are handled by Stripe and never reach our servers.
Messages you send us through the contact form or support.
Basic technical data such as IP address and browser type, used for security, rate limiting and preventing abuse.

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
list: to create, deliver and let you re-download your documents;
to process payments, refunds and subscriptions;
to verify your email, keep you signed in and protect accounts;
to answer your questions and send messages about your orders;
to prevent fraud and misuse of the service.
after: We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use document details such as SSNs for marketing or advertising.

sections.heading: 3. How we protect it
body: The pay details you enter are encrypted with AES-256 before they are stored, and all traffic to our site is encrypted in transit. Access to customer data is limited to staff who need it to run the service.

sections.heading: 4. How long we keep it
list: The pay details you enter for a document are deleted 30 days after the document is generated.
PDFs bought without an account are deleted one year after purchase. PDFs in an account stay available until you ask us to delete them.
Email verification codes are deleted within 24 hours, and sign-in sessions expire after 30 days.
Order and payment records are kept as long as needed for accounting, tax and legal obligations.

sections.heading: 5. Who we share it with
body: We share data only with service providers that host or process it for us under written contracts, including:
list: Stripe, to process payments and subscriptions;
our hosting and email delivery providers, to run the site and send your emails.
after: We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect the rights and safety of our users and the service.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies
body: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and secure your session. We do not place advertising or remarketing trackers on pages where you enter pay data.

sections.heading: 7. Your choices and rights
body: You can update your profile from your dashboard. You can ask us for a copy of your data, to correct it, or to delete it at any time by emailing privacy@paydaystubs.com or using our contact page. We may keep records we are legally required to retain.

sections.heading: 8. Children
body: The service is not intended for children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it last changed.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
body: For privacy questions or requests, email privacy@paydaystubs.com or send us a message through our contact page.
